audit_method: Manual visual inspection of every generated E0-E6 montage, cross-checked against 250 Hz contact/event traces

event_semantics.E0: Visible left-donor-only grasp of the red block
event_semantics.E1_E2: Receiver first contact and simultaneous contact occur in the same discrete physics step; both grippers visibly surround the block
event_semantics.E3: Both grippers visibly remain engaged after the 15-step stability requirement
event_semantics.E4: Donor open command occurs while receiver visibly holds the block
event_semantics.E5_E6: Left donor is visibly disengaged/retracting and the right receiver alone retains the block

visual_limit: Montages validate gross contact geometry and arm identity; exact contact state comes from simulator actor IDs and impulses
